# Project Overview

This is a modern portfolio website built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. The project uses the App Router for better performance and modern React features.

# Coding Guidelines

- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Follow React best practices and hooks
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling
- Implement responsive design patterns
- Keep components modular and reusable
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions
- Maintain clean code with proper documentation
